candidate.text: BUGFIX: A change in v1.16.0 caused cert-manager's ACME ClusterIssuer to look in the wrong namespace for resources required for the issuance (e.g. credential Secrets). This is now fixed in v1.16.1+ and v1.17.0+ (#7339, @inteon)

evidence.excerpt: - BUGFIX: A change in v1.16.0 caused cert-manager's ACME ClusterIssuer to look in the wrong namespace for resources required for the issuance (e.g. credential Secrets). This is now fixed in v1.16.1+ and v1.17.0+ ([#7339](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/7339), [@inteon](https://github.com/inteon))
